note: What the next OpenAI version changes in the plugin.json of the release ZIP. tools/build_openai_zip.py applies it; everything else (name, MCP, review cases, assets) is kept as it was.
description: Publish and manage HTML5 games on Playgama from an agent: create games, upload builds and covers, edit in-app products and leaderboards, get QA links, publish a playable sandbox and bring its first players. Its skills check and pack a build, integrate the Bridge SDK and make a trailer of the game.

longDescription.append: The plugin also brings three skills for the work on your machine. playgama-publish checks the build against Playgama's game checklist, packs the zip and makes the three covers from the game itself. playgama-bridge integrates the Bridge SDK in any engine from Playgama's live documentation. playgama-game-video films the game and makes a trailer or a Short in the game's own look.

capabilitiesAppend: Check a build against Playgama's game checklist and pack it
Integrate the Playgama Bridge SDK from its live documentation
Make a trailer or a Short from the game's own gameplay
releaseNotes: Adds three skills: playgama-publish (checks a build against the game checklist, packs the zip and makes the three covers from the game), playgama-bridge (integrates the Bridge SDK in any engine from the live documentation) and playgama-game-video (films the game and makes a trailer or a Short). The MCP server and its tools are unchanged by this package.
